Name: Outer Titan, Dustwalker
Information:
**Dustwalker**

The hounds of the outer titans, who are brought forward with cajoles during the initial incursions by outer titan forces. They are smaller than most titans, but just as vicious, and are adept in searching for life.

Dustwalkers also serve as cosmic hunters, being flung like drones through the depths of space by other outer titans to eventually crash into planetary bodies, and should they land on a life-rich world they will begin consuming eidomantic radiation, eventually gaining enough to send a signal through space to a tesseract, signaling the beginning of an incursion.

traits.name: Zero Gravity Resistance
traits.description: The titan does not suffer fall damage, nor does it suffer any negative effects or damage when entering, passing through, or exiting a planet’s atmosphere.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The titan uses its Horn and Poison Claw once each.

actions.name: Horn
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Poison Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage. The target must succeed a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) poison damage and being poisoned for 1 minute on a failure. A creature poisoned this way repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Lifesense
bonus_actions.description: The titan makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.
